title: FSSAI orders Dabur to halt sale of products claiming '100% pure', citing food regulations
summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has instructed Dabur India to stop selling products with unauthorized organic claims. The FSSAI identified misleading labels on various products, including honey, oils, and others. Dabur had claimed its products were '100% pure'.
summary_points: The FSSAI identified unauthorized organic claims on various Dabur products.
Dabur India has been instructed to halt the sale of items claiming to be '100% pure'.
The FSSAI's decision stems from a violation of food regulations deemed misleading to consumers.
The banned products include honey, oils, and others with '100% pure' claims.
Dabur had asserted that its labels were accurate.
